verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe pre-request and after-response scripting to add logic to requests (docs-37). Pre-request scripts can manipulate environment variables, auth and request contents (docs-21, docs-2). Request chaining extracts values from other responses and shares state across requests (docs-1, docs-38). Together these cover scripting, chaining and data massaging. Missing for 10: detail on the after-response scripting API and its data-transformation capabilities, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
